mechanism.claim: When the first and second four-hour BTC perpetual aggressive-quote-flow shares have the same strict sign, the second half is more extreme by an unusually large amount, realized variation is elevated, and open interest expands over the completed eight-hour cycle, directional leveraged demand is accelerating with fresh inventory and should propagate for eight hours.
mechanism.side: strict common sign of first-half and second-half BTC perpetual aggressive-quote-flow shares
mechanism.why_distinct: HVCFAR uses within-cycle acceleration of perpetual aggressive-flow magnitude plus exact OI expansion and variation. HVCPOFR used full-cycle flow level and failed train; existing flow-acceleration candidates omit exact OI sponsorship. HVCFAR reuses neither event set nor control and uses no spot source, return direction, ETH, funding, premium-index, fitted outcome, or promoted control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: the completed intervening eight-hour BTC realized variation must be in its causal upper 40 percent
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: fixed eight-hour accelerating-flow plus OI-sponsored states are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.open_interest: finite positive BTCUSDT period=5m sum_open_interest observations at D-8h and D, each exchange-timestamped no later than D
features.completed_cycle: 480 exact coherent bars_binance BTCUSDT one-minute rows with nonnegative quote_asset_volume and 0<=taker_buy_quote<=quote_asset_volume over [D-8h,D)
features.half_flow_shares: the signed aggressive quote-flow share computed separately over first and second 240-minute halves; both denominators positive, shares strict nonzero and same strict sign
features.flow_acceleration_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 270 source-valid cycles; current excluded; minimum 180; rank>=0.60
features.realized_variation: sqrt(sum squared one-minute log(close/open) returns over exactly 480 coherent BTCUSDT bars [D-8h,D))
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 270 source-valid cycles; current excluded; minimum 180; rank>=0.60
features.eligible: exact coherent completed perpetual cycle, same-sign nonzero half-flow shares with positive acceleration, two exact OI endpoints with strict expansion, and both acceleration and variation ranks pass at D; no spot source, return direction, funding, range, premium-index, alt, or post-decision condition

clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal entry
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact held settlements only after source and Gross9 pass

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.open_interest: Postgres open_interest_binance BTCUSDT period=5m exact endpoint observations
source_plan.bars: Postgres bars_binance BTCUSDT exact coherent 1m OHLC plus quote_asset_volume and taker_buy_quote
source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 pass

research_boundary.classification: exploratory discovery; not fresh confirmatory evidence

stopping_rule: terminal first failure; no OI endpoint or expansion rule, half-flow or acceleration formula, acceleration or variation history, side, clock, hold, subset, threshold, comparator, or control repair
